tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skyed lhas rtag gtor gyi zhal byang dge/ na mo gu ru tsa turmu kha ya/ ang gir zhes pa chu pho sprel lo'i mgo zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar kha'u brag rdzong nag po'i me 'bar gyi gtsug lag khang 'di nyid du/ stobs 'phrog dbang po 'khor dang bcas pa'i nang rten gtor ma gsum gyi nang tshan rtag gtor 'di nyid sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po gnyis kyis rje btsun gong ma'i man ngag nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi rgyu dbyibs gzungs gzhug rgyan mtheb skyu'i grangs snod bcas zhi rgyas kyi las gtsor ston dang / bdud rtsi dang lha sgrub rnams la dmigs pa sngags dang bcas gang yod ci shes kyi sgo nas bgyis te/ gtso bor rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i 'phrin bcol bcas lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas bsgrubs pa yin pas rjes 'jug rnams nas dus rgyun du gtor ma 'di la bsgul bskyod mi gtong / dgos pa khyad par can gyi tshe/ thod pa nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bsrung ba bkrol ba'i dmigs pa sngon 'gro'i kha gsos la/ bskang phrin bzlog bskul gang dgos bsgrubs nas slar srung ba man ngag nas 'byung ba bzhin byas pas/ gdung sras myur du 'byon pa sogs 'dod don 'bad med 'grub pa'i mtshan ma cung zad yod de gtor ma 'di bzhin byung na bsam blo yod mur/ lo 'di'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la 'dod don 'ga' zhig grub pa'i gtang rag tu gur zhal rnam gnyis gtso gyur gyi chos srung dam can rgya mtsho la mchod gtor rgyas pa phul ba'i nub nged rang gi rmi ltas su mgon khang 'di nyid sngon las rgya che zhing bla re yol ba sogs bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa'i nang da lta'i sku 'di na bza' dar tshon gzab ma bcas bzhugs khyim nas phyir cung zad 'thon pa'i zhal 'dzum gsung 'byon la khad yod pa'i drung /

bud med rgan mo zhig gis lcags phur gser tshags la dar tshon gyis brgyan pa zhig nged rang la phyag btsal nas gtad pa'i mur ka gdong gi gtor sgam zhal byang la brten nas gtor ma bzhengs rgyu yin snyam pa'i mur 'khrul snang gzhan zhig la 'byams nas ma byung / dngos gzhi rmi lam tsam la dpang gtad byed rgyu mi 'dug kyang / mgon po che chung gi bsnyen thabs rnams nas rmi lam du gtor ma bzhengs pa dang / dngos su'ang stegs pa snyam byed pa byung na gtor ma 'dod pa yin pas gtor ma 'bul zhes dang / bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig la'ang mnal lam du brda bskul byung ba sogs dang phyogs mthun tsam du 'dug snyam nas/ rtag gtor 'di bzhin lag len du thebs par bgyis pa la zhing skyong dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes nas 'khon gyi gdung rgyun mi chad pa dang kun blo spun 'khor dang bcas pa la/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //i daṃ shā sa nañca satwa hi twa bha wan+tu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ skyed lhas rtag gtor gyi zhal byang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
